entries.name: Customer order total
entries.description: Sum of the amount column for one customer. Review currency, order status and time scope before publishing.

template.query_json: {"query":"WITH totals AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders WHERE customer_id = @customer_id GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT customer_id, total FROM totals","named_params":{"customer_id":0}}
template.result_description: Native customer_id and total columns; an unknown customer returns zero rows.
